Degík, also known as Life-vine, grows in the hot, humid regions of Endor, particularly along coasts and saltwater shores. Its leaves are gathered in these coastal habitats, where the plant is difficult to find.

A leaf taken directly can stabilize a person on the verge of death for about one day. This respite gives healers time to intervene and treat the injuries. Repeated use of Degík carries a risk of habituation.
